text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival!
I came to cheer on Zenno Rob Roy,
who was participating in a team event, but—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Things are heating up, everyone!
It's the team vs. team VR game: 'Find the Orb!'"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A race against the clock to clear the mission!
The next team taking on the challenge is—
these four members!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
HELL YEAH, LET'S GOOO!
Bring it on, whether you're a Demon King or a dragon!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best so everyone can have a great time!
And of course, I'll aim for a personal best♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, guess I'll keep taking it nice and easy~

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (What incredible cheering...! That's because all my seniors here have amazing skill and huge expectations from the crowd...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'll do my best to be helpful
to everyone! I'll give it my all to support—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Countin' on ya, Leader!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —...Huh? Leader?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"The roly-poly toy stopped right while pointing at you!
This is a divine revelation, I'm leavin' it to ya!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Then Team Zenno Rob Roy,
challenge... start!

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eeehhhh...!?
Ahhh, it's already started...!

text_block_list.name: Comedian Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, let's go, dammit!
I'll blow every single one of 'em away!

text_block_list.name: Mage Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, nice to be working with you, Leader Rob Roy-chan♪
So, what should we do first?

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh, um, well...!

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I-I'm a little anxious... but as the leader,
I have to do my best to support my seniors...!)

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: L-Let's start by gathering information...!
And so, the challenge began under the leadership of Zenno Rob Roy, but...

text_block_list.name: Villager
text_block_list.text:
"Azure Jewel"? You can get those from wyverns.
Looks like swordsmen hunt them a lot and come
sell them in town.

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(If so, it might shave down some time
if I just look for something pre-made, I guess...)

text_block_list.name: Comedian Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A Wyvern, you say?!
That bastard's still alive?!
Let's go beat him down right now!!

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Huh!? ...Ah, but that would definitely
get the crowd more excited...
I guess it fits a Fan Appreciation Festival, but... still...)

text_block_list.name: Merchant Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, isn't fighting such a drag?
Let's just stroll around town and go shopping instead~

text_block_list.name: Comedian Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The hell did you say!? Sky, you're the super lazy type!?
Squishy-wishy Sky-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Mage Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, whether it's defeating a wyvern
or searching for one in shops,
I think both sound fun, but—

text_block_list.name: Mage Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Let's leave the call to our leader here.
Rob Roy-chan, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Um, I thought searching around the shops might help shave down our time...!

text_block_list.name: Comedian Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tch, well if the leader says so, can't be helped.
Right now I'm just a regular employee...
Boss, I'm followin' you!!

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(――Sky-san and Laurel-san were covering for me just now, weren't they...?
N-Next time, I've really gotta get my act together!)

text_block_list.name: Chicken-type Monster
text_block_list.text:
GYAAAHHH!
THE TREASURE ORB! LEAVE THE TREASURE ORB BEHIND!

text_block_list.name: Merchant Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~ A battle, huh?
Didn't think I'd get held up here~

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(C-Combat...! As the leader,
I should be the one coming up with our tactics, right...?!)

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Um, Laurel-san is a Mage, so rear support...?
What kind of skills does Golshi-san have as an Entertainer...?
Um, um, ummm...?!)

text_block_list.name: Mage Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Both of you, step back a bit!
Hyah, Defense Magic!

text_block_list.name: Comedian Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, eat this, bird-brain!
Charm Attack: Golshi-chan Mirror Ballll!!
(*BOOM!*)

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry...!
I couldn't do anything...!

text_block_list.name: Mage Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: That's not true! Rob Roy-chan is doing a great job thinking things through as our leader. We're almost there, so let's take it easy and keep going♪

And so, having successfully overcome the battle,
the goal seemed just around the corner, but—

text_block_list.name: Giant Dragon
text_block_list.text: Gwooooooooh!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, and here comes the final boss!
None of the teams that have crossed the finish line have defeated it yet!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: "Indeed, if you wait a certain amount of time, the dragon goes to sleep! In this time-attack trial... will they gamble on a fight, or play it safe and wait?!"

text_block_list.name: Mage Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Whoa, they look super strong...!

text_block_list.name: Mage Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if I want to make it to the goal for sure,
maybe the smart move here is to wait until they fall asleep?

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, but if it's a dragon—

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...No, that might not really be the case...
If I make a mistake and cause even more trouble...)

Zenno Rob Roy moved to step forward for a second, but seemed to hesitate over something. However...
With her innate knowledge and courage, she will surely—!
choice_data_list: Rob Roy! You can do it!
Rob Roy! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hah—!

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(...Right. The person I want to be
would never hesitate over something like this...!)

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(――I've read plenty of fantasy stories, too.
I know all about dragons' traits...)

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The one who knows best is—me!

text_block_list.name: Comedian Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Seriously, when is this guy gonna sleep?! Is she one of those people who can't sleep with a different pillow? Needs memory foam, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Please step back!!

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"We don't possess a legendary sword...
In that case, let us consult the wisdom of shoemakers!"

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san! Do you happen to have any
powder-type items on you!?

text_block_list.name: Merchant Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Powders, huh~... Well, I've got some sulfur for gunpowder
that I picked up in town earlier."

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please throw lots of them
into the dragon's mouth!

text_block_list.name: Merchant Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: In your mouth... OK, here comes everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This should make the dragon terribly thirsty!
Laurel-san, use your magic to give it water!

text_block_list.name: Mage Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu, roger that! Hup!

text_block_list.name: Giant Dragon
text_block_list.text: Glub glub glub... glub... *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? The dragon is gulping down water—
and inflating like a balloon!!

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san! Do you happen to have anything
resembling a scroll among your belongings!?

text_block_list.name: Comedian Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"A scroll...?
—C-Could this be... the path to becoming a Sage...?!"

text_block_list.name: Sage Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO! Enlightenment awaits!
Sage Golshi is boooorn!!

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—Thank goodness, the class change succeeded...!
Now all that remains is to burst that
ballooned-up dragon!

text_block_list.name: Sage Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, Leader!
Here goes my high-tier magic—Skewer Icicle!!

text_block_list.name: Swordsman Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I will, too—!
Haaaaaaah!
(BAAANG!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
GOOOOAL!
A phenomenal time after toppling the final boss!
That was simply magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Bravo to Rob Roy's sensational performance as well!
Taking command without showing any fear in front of her seniors,
she truly embodies the image of a hero!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: !? H-Hero, no, that's... um...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You looked so cool!
Just like a professional dragon slayer♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm. Who knew Rob Roy had such a brave side to her? What a surprise~.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
("You were amazing, Rob Roy-chaaan!")
("Woooo, Hero! Hero!!")

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Hero Rob Roy!
Care to give us a comment?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... augh... um, er...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so glad I could be of help! Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Contestant Rob Roy has fled the scene~!
Could it be that she's just super shy?!

Zenno Rob Roy's performance captured the hearts
of many in the crowd, but unused to the limelight,
she hurriedly left the stage.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I... I am... a hero...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What the heck, Rob Roy! Don't tell me
you're the reincarnation of the legendary Sulfur-nist!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you did a wonderful job leading them.
Your instructions were spot on—I was really impressed♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, the audience is hyped up too.
It's all thanks to Rob Roy's great performance~.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: No, really, I'm...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
("Way to go, Zenno Rob Roy~!")
("Rob Roy-chan was so cool!")

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Ah... Trainer's voice...)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Hero Rob Roy!
Care to give us a comment?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um... I'm deeply honored. But this was by no means achieved through my efforts alone.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to the team, and—
...and all the voices cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much...!

After her heroic rampage in the game,
Zenno Rob Roy came out of it
just a little bit tougher.
